sections_structure.name: Header
sections_structure.layout: Sticky top-0 z-50 glassmorphism. Logo left, Links center, CTA right. Links: Inicio, Nosotros, Soluciones, Sistemas, Clientes, Servicios, Contacto.

sections_structure.name: Hero
sections_structure.layout: Split layout or large typography overlapping image. H1: 'Soluciones Inteligentes para Edificios Seguros, Eficientes y Conectados'. Generous whitespace. Right side/Background: Architectural glass building image with subtle zoom animation.

sections_structure.name: Nosotros (Mision & Vision)
sections_structure.layout: Two columns. Left: Massive '12+' typography (years of experience) in #00B368. Right: Mission and Vision text blocks with clean typography and plenty of breathing room.

sections_structure.name: Soluciones
sections_structure.layout: Tetris Mode A. 7 items (BMS, PCI, Seguridad, GRMS, Infraestructura, Audio y Video, Servicios). Mix of tall, wide, and square cards. Some cards use photography, some use icons/text.

sections_structure.name: Dashboard BMS Showcase
sections_structure.layout: Dark or Light massive container (Control Room look). Mock UI of a dashboard showing Energy Consumption (chart), Temp (thermostat image), Active Equipment, Alarms. Use Shadcn charts or Recharts for data visualization.

sections_structure.name: Stats & Por qué Greentech
sections_structure.layout: Grid of 3-4 large numbers with overlines (Years, Projects, Certifications). Minimalist, large typography.

sections_structure.name: Partners & Clientes
sections_structure.layout: Two opposing scrolling marquees (react-fast-marquee). Marquee 1 (Tech Partners): Use react-icons (SiCisco, SiHoneywell, etc.) or stylized text. Marquee 2 (Clients): JW Marriott, Hilton, ZARA in elegant serif or sans typography.

sections_structure.name: Testimonios
sections_structure.layout: Clean cards with quotes, subtle borders, no heavy shadows. Generous padding inside cards.

sections_structure.name: Contacto
sections_structure.layout: Two columns. Left: Contact Form (Shadcn inputs) + Contact Info. Right: Minimalist map representation or image of location.

sections_structure.name: Footer
sections_structure.layout: Dark theme (bg-zinc-950). Massive 'GREENTECH' text at the bottom. Links, address (Av. Los Próceres, Diamond Mall).

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for UI icons. For brand logos (Cisco, Honeywell, Hikvision, Johnson Controls) use react-icons (e.g. SiCisco, SiHoneywell) if available, or render them as stylized text (e.g., HONEYWELL) to avoid using placeholders. Never use placeholder images.

animations.entrance: Use framer-motion. Initial: { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.6, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }
animations.stagger: Stagger children in grids (e.g., Soluciones, Stats) by 0.1s.
animations.hover: Scale images slightly on card hover (scale-105) with smooth transition.
animations.marquee: Slow, continuous drift for client/partner logos.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'framer-motion' for all entry animations.
Install and use 'react-fast-marquee' for the Partners and Clients sections.
Use 'recharts' or Shadcn Charts for the BMS Dashboard Mock section to show realistic looking line/bar charts for energy consumption.
Do NOT use generic placeholder images (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs or create stylized UI blocks.
For the floating WhatsApp button, use a fixed positioned button at bottom-right with a green background and a WhatsApp icon (from lucide-react or react-icons) with a subtle pulse animation.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-form-submit').
Strictly follow the 'Outfit' (headings) and 'Satoshi' (body) typography. If they need to be imported, use Google Fonts or standard imports.
Keep the design 'not overloaded' (no recargada) by strictly adhering to the generous padding (py-24/py-32) and white space.
For the 7 solutions, build a creative Bento Grid (some spanning 2 cols, some 1 col) rather than a boring equal grid.
